title: Pretty but not sure practical.
text: Pretty but not sure practical.. The Soma ceramic mug is pretty. I would even say eye catching. The body is two toned, soft blue (mint) and white, with a bamboo twist-off lid. I would suggest washing it by hand, although the body (not the lid) can be washed in the dishwasher. It can keep liquids hot or cold. While I think this mug is a nice gift for a tea or coffee lover, I would hesitate to give it 5 stars.  Why? (1) When full, this mug is heavy. (2) It is a little pricey ($30 for 12 ounces). (3) Taking care of this mug is tricky. Hand wash is recommended.

product_metadata.title: Soma Insulated Ceramic Mug with Bamboo Lid, Mint, 12oz
features: Double-walled ceramic insulates your beverages to keep them hot
Sophisticated color blocked glazes in matte/gloss combinations makes them as beautiful as they are practical
Hand-wash with Warm, soapy water; pearl is not dishwasher safe.
description: This simple, beautiful design holds 12 oz. Of your favorite hot (or cold) beverage. Our leak-proof bamboo lid allows you to travel at ease, double-wall insulation keeps your liquids hot, and drinking from ceramic upholds pure taste – wherever you go. Double-walled ceramic insulates your beverages to keep them hot even after you've commute to work, checked your email and then remembered you brought Coffee. The leak-proof bamboo lid lets you to take the purity of your ceramic drinking experience with you. With a two-tone matte finish and straight silhouette, the mug was designed to look great on your desk or in your hand — because beauty is the perfect complement to function.
